controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Create a baseline configuration for all hardware, software, services, and networks, ensuring that security configurations are included.
Document all configurations and maintain an up-to-date configuration management database (CMDB).
Implement automated tools to monitor configurations for compliance with established baselines and detect unauthorized changes.
Conduct regular reviews and audits of configurations to ensure they remain secure and compliant with organizational policies.

controls.name: information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

deployment_points.name: Develop and implement a data retention policy that specifies the criteria for when information should be deleted.
Ensure that all employees are trained on the importance of data deletion and the procedures to follow.
Utilize secure deletion methods that comply with industry standards to ensure that deleted information cannot be recovered.
Regularly audit and review deletion processes to ensure compliance with the data retention policy.

controls.name: data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive data that requires masking based on the organization's access control policies and business requirements.
Implement data masking techniques that comply with relevant legislation and industry standards to protect sensitive information.
Regularly review and update data masking policies and procedures to ensure they remain effective and aligned with business needs.
Train employees on the importance of data masking and the specific procedures to follow when handling sensitive data.

controls.name: data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify sensitive information that requires protection from leakage across all systems and networks.
Implement data leakage prevention (DLP) solutions that monitor and control the movement of sensitive data.
Establish policies and procedures for handling sensitive information, including encryption and access controls.
Regularly test and update DLP measures to ensure they effectively prevent data leakage.

controls.name: information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods for backing up information, software, and systems.
Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and reliable backups are created.
Regularly test backup copies to verify their integrity and ensure they can be restored successfully.
Maintain documentation of backup processes and results of testing to ensure compliance with the backup policy.

controls.name: redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the availability requirements of critical information processing facilities to determine necessary redundancy levels.
Implement redundant systems, networks, and components to ensure continuous operation in the event of a failure.
Regularly test redundancy measures to ensure they function as intended during outages or failures.
Document redundancy configurations and maintain an updated inventory of redundant resources.

controls.name: logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

deployment_points.name: Establish logging policies that define what events should be logged, including activities, exceptions, and faults.
Implement logging mechanisms across all systems and applications to capture relevant events.
Ensure logs are securely stored and protected from unauthorized access or tampering.
Regularly analyze logs to identify anomalies and potential security incidents, and maintain documentation of findings.

controls.name: monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools that continuously observe networks, systems, and applications for signs of anomalous behavior.
Define thresholds and alerts for identifying potential security incidents based on established baselines.
Establish a response plan that outlines actions to be taken when anomalies are detected, including escalation procedures.
Regularly review monitoring processes and update them to adapt to new threats and changes in the environment.

controls.name: clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all utility programs that have the capability to override system and application controls.
Establish a policy that restricts access to these utility programs to only authorized personnel.
Implement access controls and logging mechanisms to monitor the use of these utility programs.
Regularly review and audit the access logs to ensure compliance with the established policy.

controls.name: installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a software installation policy that outlines the approval process for new software.
Implement a change management process to track and approve software installations.
Ensure that all software is obtained from trusted sources and is scanned for malware before installation.
Maintain an inventory of installed software and regularly review it for compliance with the software installation policy.

controls.name: network security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in the network and network devices.
Implement firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and other security measures to protect the network perimeter.
Regularly update and patch network devices to mitigate security vulnerabilities.
Monitor network traffic for suspicious activity and respond to incidents as they occur.

controls.name: security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Define security requirements for all network services based on organizational needs and risk assessments.
Implement security mechanisms such as encryption and access controls for network services.
Establish service level agreements (SLAs) that include security performance metrics.
Regularly monitor and review the performance of network services against the defined security requirements and SLAs.

controls.name: segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organizationΓÇÖs networks.

deployment_points.name: Identify and categorize information services, users, and information systems that require segregation.
Design the network architecture to implement physical or logical segmentation based on the identified categories.
Configure network devices to enforce segregation policies and restrict access between different segments.
Regularly review and update the segregation policies to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a cryptography policy that outlines the acceptable use of cryptographic methods and key management practices.
Implement cryptographic solutions for data at rest and in transit as per the defined policy.
Establish procedures for the generation, distribution, storage, and destruction of cryptographic keys.
Regularly review and audit cryptographic practices to ensure compliance with the established policy.

controls.name: application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for identifying and documenting information security requirements during the application development lifecycle.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the approval process for security requirements to ensure alignment with organizational policies.
Conduct security assessments of applications during development and prior to deployment to ensure compliance with the specified requirements.
Maintain records of security requirements and assessments for future reference and audits.

controls.name: secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document secure system architecture principles that align with industry best practices.
Ensure that all information system development activities adhere to the established secure architecture principles.
Conduct training for development teams on secure engineering practices and principles.
Regularly review and update the secure architecture documentation to reflect changes in technology and threats.

controls.name: security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development and acceptance life cycle.

deployment_points.name: Define a security testing strategy that outlines the types of tests to be conducted during development and acceptance phases.
Integrate security testing into the development lifecycle, ensuring it is performed at key milestones.
Document the results of security tests and track remediation efforts for identified vulnerabilities.
Conduct regular reviews of the security testing processes to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management process that includes documentation of all proposed changes to information processing facilities and systems.
Implement a review and approval workflow for changes, ensuring that all changes are assessed for potential impact on security and operations.
Train relevant personnel on the change management procedures to ensure compliance and understanding of the process.
Monitor and log all changes made to systems and facilities, maintaining records for audit purposes.

controls.name: protection of information systems during audit
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

controls.name: user end point devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user end point devices shall be protected.

controls.name: privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.name: protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

controls.name: web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.name: secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.

controls.name: secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

controls.name: development, testing and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

controls.name: test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

public.framework_categories.description: International standard for establishing, implementing, and maintaining an Information Security Management System (ISMS).

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Roles and responsibilities for information security shall be defined and communicated to all relevant personnel.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Segregation of duties shall be implemented to reduce the risk of unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of information.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall be responsible for ensuring that information security is integrated into the organization's processes and practices.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be established to ensure effective communication during incidents.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Contacts with special interest groups shall be established to stay informed about information security threats and best practices.

controls.name: threat intelligence
controls.description: Threat intelligence shall be collected and analyzed to inform decision-making regarding information security.

controls.name: inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets shall be maintained to support information security management.

controls.name: acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An acceptable use policy for information and other associated assets shall be established and communicated to all users.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: Procedures for the return of assets shall be established to ensure that all assets are returned when no longer needed.

controls.name: labelling of information
controls.description: Information shall be labelled according to its classification to ensure appropriate handling and protection.

controls.name: access control
controls.description: Access to information and information processing facilities shall be controlled based on business and security requirements.

controls.name: identity management
controls.description: Identity management processes shall be established to ensure that only authorized individuals have access to information and systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document identity management policies that outline the processes for granting, modifying, and revoking access to information and systems.
Implement a centralized identity management system to automate the onboarding and offboarding of users, ensuring that access is granted only to authorized individuals.
Conduct regular audits of user access rights to verify compliance with identity management policies and to identify any unauthorized access.
Provide training for staff on identity management processes and the importance of safeguarding access credentials.

controls.name: access rights
controls.description: Access rights to information and information processing facilities shall be granted based on the principle of least privilege.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for determining access rights based on job roles and responsibilities, ensuring that users receive the minimum level of access necessary to perform their duties.
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) to streamline the assignment of access rights according to predefined roles within the organization.
Regularly review and adjust access rights to reflect changes in job functions or organizational structure, ensuring compliance with the principle of least privilege.
Document all access rights granted and maintain an audit trail for accountability and compliance purposes.

controls.name: information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be established and communicated to suppliers to ensure the protection of information.

deployment_points.name: Identify and document specific information security requirements that suppliers must adhere to, based on the sensitivity of the information being shared.
Communicate these requirements clearly to all suppliers during the onboarding process and ensure they understand their responsibilities.
Establish a process for regularly reviewing supplier compliance with the information security requirements, including audits and assessments.
Maintain a record of supplier agreements that include the established information security requirements for accountability.

controls.name: addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Supplier agreements shall include information security requirements to ensure compliance and protection of information.

deployment_points.name: Review and update supplier agreements to include specific clauses that outline the information security requirements and expectations.
Ensure that all new supplier contracts are reviewed by the legal and information security teams to confirm compliance with organizational policies.
Implement a process for monitoring supplier adherence to the information security requirements outlined in the agreements.
Conduct regular training sessions for procurement and contract management teams on the importance of including information security in supplier agreements.

controls.name: managing information security in the ict supply chain
controls.description: Information security risks in the ICT supply chain shall be managed to protect the organization's information.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment of the ICT supply chain to identify potential information security risks associated with suppliers and third-party vendors.
Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate identified risks, including regular monitoring and evaluation of supplier performance.
Establish clear communication channels with suppliers to ensure timely reporting of any security incidents or vulnerabilities.
Create a contingency plan for addressing information security incidents that may arise from the ICT supply chain.

controls.name: monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Supplier services shall be monitored and reviewed to ensure compliance with information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Implement a monitoring framework to regularly assess supplier services against established information security requirements.
Schedule periodic reviews of supplier performance and compliance, documenting findings and any necessary corrective actions.
Establish a change management process to evaluate the impact of any changes in supplier services on information security.
Communicate results of monitoring and reviews to relevant stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.

controls.name: information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be established for the use of cloud services to protect organizational information.

deployment_points.name: Define specific information security requirements for cloud service providers, including data encryption, access controls, and incident response protocols.
Conduct due diligence on potential cloud service providers to ensure they meet the established security requirements before engagement.
Implement a process for continuous monitoring of cloud services to ensure compliance with the defined information security requirements.
Provide training for employees on the secure use of cloud services and the importance of adhering to established security protocols.

controls.name: information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Incident management planning and preparation shall be established to ensure effective response to information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Develop an incident management plan that outlines roles, responsibilities, and procedures for responding to information security incidents.
Conduct regular training and simulation exercises for incident response teams to ensure preparedness for potential incidents.
Establish communication protocols for reporting incidents internally and externally, including notification of affected stakeholders.
Review and update the incident management plan regularly to incorporate lessons learned from past incidents and changes in the threat landscape.

controls.name: assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: A process for assessing and making decisions on information security events shall be established to ensure timely response.

deployment_points.name: Create a standardized process for assessing information security events, including criteria for categorizing the severity and impact of events.
Establish a decision-making framework that outlines who is responsible for making decisions based on the assessment of security events.
Implement a tracking system to document the assessment and decision-making process for each security event.
Conduct regular reviews of the assessment and decision-making process to identify areas for improvement and ensure effectiveness.

controls.name: response to information security incidents
controls.description: A response plan for information security incidents shall be established and communicated to relevant personnel.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive response plan that outlines the steps to be taken in the event of an information security incident.
Identify and designate relevant personnel who will be responsible for executing the response plan.
Communicate the response plan to all relevant personnel through training sessions and documentation.
Regularly review and update the response plan to ensure it remains effective and relevant.

controls.name: learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Lessons learned from information security incidents shall be documented and used to improve security practices.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for documenting lessons learned from each information security incident.
Create a repository for storing documented lessons and ensure it is accessible to relevant personnel.
Schedule regular review meetings to discuss documented lessons and identify areas for improvement in security practices.
Implement changes to security practices based on the insights gained from the lessons learned.

controls.name: collection of evidence
controls.description: Procedures for the collection of evidence related to information security incidents shall be established to support investigations.

deployment_points.name: Develop detailed procedures for the collection of evidence during information security incidents, including what types of evidence to collect.
Train relevant personnel on the established procedures to ensure proper evidence collection.
Ensure that evidence collection procedures comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
Regularly review and update the evidence collection procedures to adapt to new threats and technologies.

controls.name: information security during disruption
controls.description: Information security measures shall be maintained during disruptions to ensure continued protection of information.

deployment_points.name: Identify potential disruptions that could affect information security and develop contingency plans for each scenario.
Implement technical and administrative controls to maintain information security during disruptions.
Train personnel on the importance of maintaining security measures during disruptions and the specific actions they should take.
Regularly test and update the contingency plans to ensure their effectiveness in real-world scenarios.

controls.name: legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to information security shall be identified and complied with.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive assessment to identify all applicable legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to information security.
Develop a compliance framework that outlines how each requirement will be met.
Assign responsibility for compliance monitoring to specific personnel or teams.
Regularly review and update the compliance framework to reflect changes in laws and regulations.

controls.name: privacy and protection of personal identifiable information (pii)
controls.description: Measures shall be implemented to protect personal identifiable information (PII) in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

deployment_points.name: Identify all types of personal identifiable information (PII) that the organization collects, processes, and stores.
Implement technical measures such as encryption and access controls to protect PII.
Develop and enforce policies and procedures for handling PII in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Train employees on the importance of PII protection and the specific measures in place to safeguard it.

controls.name: independent review of information security
controls.description: An independent review of the information security management system shall be conducted to ensure its effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Engage an independent third-party auditor to conduct a review of the information security management system.
Define the scope and objectives of the independent review to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Provide the auditor with access to relevant documentation and personnel for the review process.
Review the findings of the independent audit and develop an action plan to address any identified weaknesses.

controls.name: compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Compliance with established policies, rules, and standards for information security shall be monitored and enforced.

deployment_points.name: Establish a monitoring framework to regularly assess compliance with information security policies, rules, and standards.
Assign specific personnel or teams to be responsible for compliance monitoring and reporting.
Develop a process for addressing non-compliance issues, including corrective actions and disciplinary measures.
Regularly review and update compliance monitoring processes to ensure they remain effective.

controls.name: documented operating procedures
controls.description: Documented operating procedures for information security shall be established and maintained to ensure consistent implementation.

deployment_points.name: Develop comprehensive documented operating procedures for all key information security processes.
Ensure that documented procedures are easily accessible to all relevant personnel.
Train employees on the documented procedures to ensure understanding and compliance.
Regularly review and update the documented procedures to reflect changes in technology and best practices.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined and approved by management.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be integrated into project management processes.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to its sensitivity and importance to the organization.

controls.name: information transfer
controls.description: Procedures for the secure transfer of information shall be established and implemented.

controls.name: authentication information
controls.description: Authentication information shall be managed securely to prevent unauthorized access.

controls.name: ict readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT systems shall be prepared to support business continuity in the event of a disruption.

controls.name: intellectual property rights
controls.description: Intellectual property rights shall be protected to prevent unauthorized use or disclosure.

controls.name: protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected to ensure their integrity, availability, and confidentiality.

controls.name: screening
controls.description: The organization shall conduct background checks on candidates for employment, contractors, and third-party users to verify their identity and assess their suitability for the role.

deployment_points.name: Develop a standardized background check policy that outlines the types of checks to be conducted, including identity verification, criminal history, and employment verification.
Identify and select a reliable third-party service provider to conduct background checks, ensuring they comply with relevant laws and regulations.
Implement a process for obtaining consent from candidates before conducting background checks, ensuring transparency and compliance with privacy laws.
Establish a review process to assess the results of background checks and determine the suitability of candidates for the role, documenting the decision-making process.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The organization shall define and document the terms and conditions of employment that include information security responsibilities.

deployment_points.name: Draft a comprehensive document outlining the terms and conditions of employment, specifically including sections on information security responsibilities.
Ensure that all employees receive a copy of the documented terms and conditions during the onboarding process and obtain their acknowledgment of understanding.
Regularly review and update the terms and conditions to reflect changes in information security policies and legal requirements.
Communicate any updates to existing employees and provide training on the implications of these terms on their roles.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that all employees and relevant third-party users receive appropriate information security awareness training.

deployment_points.name: Develop a structured information security awareness training program that covers key topics relevant to the organizationΓÇÖs security policies and procedures.
Schedule regular training sessions for all employees and relevant third-party users, ensuring participation is tracked and documented.
Create supplementary materials, such as newsletters or e-learning modules, to reinforce training concepts and provide ongoing education.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the training program through assessments and feedback, making adjustments as necessary to improve content and delivery.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: The organization shall establish a disciplinary process for employees who fail to comply with information security policies and procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear disciplinary policy that outlines the consequences of non-compliance with information security policies, including potential penalties.
Communicate the disciplinary process to all employees, ensuring they understand the implications of failing to adhere to security policies.
Establish a review committee to assess incidents of non-compliance and determine appropriate disciplinary actions based on severity and context.
Document all disciplinary actions taken and maintain records for future reference and compliance audits.

controls.name: responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: The organization shall define and communicate the responsibilities of employees after termination or change of employment regarding information security.

deployment_points.name: Create a formal policy that outlines the responsibilities of employees regarding information security after their employment ends or changes.
Ensure that all employees are informed of their ongoing responsibilities during the exit interview process, including the return of company property and confidentiality obligations.
Implement a checklist for HR and IT departments to follow during the offboarding process to ensure all security measures are enforced.
Regularly review and update the policy to reflect changes in legal requirements and organizational practices.

controls.name: confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: The organization shall require employees and relevant third-party users to sign confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements to protect sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Draft a standard confidentiality or non-disclosure agreement template that clearly defines sensitive information and the obligations of the signatories.
Require all employees and relevant third-party users to sign the agreement as part of the onboarding process or before accessing sensitive information.
Maintain a secure repository of signed agreements and regularly review them to ensure compliance and relevance.
Provide training on the importance of confidentiality and the implications of breaching the agreement.

controls.name: remote working
controls.description: The organization shall establish policies and procedures to ensure the security of information when employees are working remotely.

deployment_points.name: Develop a remote working policy that outlines security requirements for employees working outside the office, including the use of secure connections and devices.
Provide training to employees on best practices for securing information while working remotely, including data protection and incident reporting procedures.
Implement technical controls such as VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint security solutions to protect organizational data accessed remotely.
Regularly review and update the remote working policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.

controls.name: information security event reporting
controls.description: The organization shall establish a process for reporting information security events and weaknesses in a timely manner.

deployment_points.name: Create a formal reporting process that outlines how employees should report information security events and weaknesses, including contact points and escalation procedures.
Train employees on the importance of timely reporting and the steps to follow when they identify a potential security event.
Implement a tracking system to log reported events and weaknesses, ensuring that they are addressed promptly and effectively.
Regularly review reported events to identify trends and areas for improvement in security practices.
